notes: Run of 2026-11-23. One SF YIMBY story queued: Planning accepted the formal application for the 36-story tower at 1301 Van Ness, a new step after the preliminary filing published on 2026-10-15. Published.

findings.description: Planning accepted the formal application for a 36-story, 390-foot mixed-use tower of about 443 units at 1301 Van Ness, under SB 330 and the Housing Choice SF program. The existing 1911–12 Goodyear building is again found a historic resource. A proposal: nothing goes in building.

extra.note: The article restates the existing building's architects as Cunningham and Politeo, which the page already carries; nothing to fill.

raw.text: The San Francisco Planning Department has accepted the formal application for a proposed 36-story mixed-use tower at 1301 Van Ness Avenue.
